integrity: Proof uses the classical Legendre three-square characterization; exact finite tests corroborate but are not the source of infinite validity. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to nonnegative sums of three integer squares and affine maps of positive integer slope and nonnegative intercept; the reported density counts positive intercepts. An earlier equivalent result under another name may exist; priority not independently audited.
title: Affine preservers of three-square integers and their exact density
